review: independent AI-assisted source review, no rerun
calibration: Actual locked-access API denies calibration locked-test reads before reader execution; post-await lock verification retained.
All dimensions and consistent feature sets enforced; duplicate and foreign/hash-drift observations rejected.
Missing/withheld/reference-missing pairs retain expected denominator and worst loss. Unknown feature weight cannot be renormalized away.
Deterministic tie-breaks, sensitivity deltas, rollback version and hashes retained. No production policy mutation or implicit representative authority.
corpusDrill: Bounded eight-object/256-KiB exact run-scoped synthetic IO ports; source rights/group/owner checks precede IO.
Intent/terminal audit failures withhold intake/read success and returned bytes; privacy cleanup still attempted and audit failure retained.
No upsert; positive absence required; ambiguous uploads retain cleanup inventory; readback verifies exact hash.
Removal requires owned expected bytes, verifies actual absence, retains no-op/remove/audit errors; unknown absence is never success.
Revoke changes in-memory rights before audit; post-download/post-audit access barrier denies in-flight reads after revocation/deletion. Upload-pending cleanup cannot claim completion.
limits: These modules consume caller-authenticated actor/authority and current-manifest inputs; they are not a persistent authentication/repository service.
Injected storage tests are control behavior, not a live Supabase receipt. No DB/Docker/provider operation performed in this review.
A unique run scope and truthful provider-specific not-found adapter remain caller responsibilities.
Calibration proposal readiness does not establish sufficient sample size, representative validity, public claims or production adoption. Actual evaluation and external acceptance remain separate.
